translations.about.heading: Over 20 years building technology
translations.about.bio.p1: I am an IT professional with over {$INTERPOLATION} years of experience, with a career spanning operations, systems support, databases, front-end, back-end, business analysis and consulting, at companies such as Nielsen, Vivo, Coca-Cola, Santander and TOTVS.
translations.about.bio.p2: I have seen technology evolve up close, from batch processing and data administration to web applications and DevOps pipelines. Today, at TOTVS, I build the front-end with Angular and generative AI, and I am enthusiastic about living through the era of Cloud, Data and AI.
translations.about.bio.p3: I am passionate about what I do and I keep learning constantly, always seeking to understand the business problem before writing the first line of code.

translations.hero.title: Hi, I'm Johnny 👋
translations.hero.bio: I'm an IT professional with over {$INTERPOLATION} years of experience, working across technical support, databases, front-end, back-end and business analysis, and implementing, configuring and providing systems consulting to a wide range of companies.
translations.project.subtitle: Some of the projects I've been part of
translations.project.pitcher.description: Coca-Cola FEMSA replaced the MfCoke app with Pitcher App to streamline the daily work of its sales promoters. I was responsible for the rollout: integrating the databases (MS-SQL Server and SAP), managing customer information in Salesforce with formulas and dynamic charts, and installing and configuring the app on the devices of more than 3,000 employees. The data collected feeds graphical reports that speed up decision-making.
translations.project.profuturo.description: A preschool and elementary education system delivered on tablets to children around the world, with interactive screens and available in several languages. I built the front-end with HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript and, to improve performance, we migrated from jQuery to plain JavaScript with PIXI.js. We created an API with the project features and templates that sped up production, automated tasks with Grunt and versioned the code on GitLab.
